lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 6 faint vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is non-uniform, with more compression in the mid-torso and wider gaps in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines on the posterior torso terminate at the boundary of the shaggy ventral fringe; the line nearest the shoulder terminates at the mid-shoulder point.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 4 distinct high-contrast white spots observed on the posterior flank, located vertically between the dorsal ridge and the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower posterior flank align in a diagonal trajectory angled approximately 30 degrees toward the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate horns with a spiral trajectory, projecting posteriorly and dorsally from the frontal bone with a marked lateral flare at the mid-point.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between apical tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 15% of the total vertical horn length from base to apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white chevron between the eyes and two white spots on the lower cheek; distinctive white transverse bands visible on the lower limbs above the dark 'sock' pigmentation.
